observationsForReviewerAndArchitect: Not this change, pre-existing: skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md tells the controller to use `legion({ op: "set_status", ... })`, but packages/pi-envoy/extensions/legion.ts registers the `legion` tool only for architect sessions (`legion is available only to root and sub-architect sessions`; unchanged vs main@origin 7add4d03). The rig controller noticed (`xd://legion -> no such tool`) and used the CLI `legion status <KEY> <status>` through its grant-wrapped bash instead, which works because of this branch's T8. Worth a skill fix or a tool registration for the controller in a follow-up issue; it does not block this PR.

The daemon never logs HTTP 4xx responses (api.ts serializes HttpError straight to the response), so `daemon log shows the 403` cannot be observed for the merge refusal; the raw HTTP 403 bodies above are the daemon-side proof.
